misprints.note: Under Förskingra: the print clearly reads διασκευάσασθαι, but the sense ('squander one's fortune') calls for διασκεδάσασθαι, which fits διασκεδαννύναι earlier in the same entry.

uncertain.note: The marks over ε are small. They read as a smooth breathing and an acute, so I wrote ἔν, not ἕν or ἒν.
No breathing or accent is visible on the ending ουσα, so I wrote it unaccented as printed.
